metadata.description: Official fee-source registry for real medical institutions; numeric fee amounts remain null until verified against the applicable current official fee order or prospectus.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Verify each fee claim against the applicable current official fee order, prospectus or counselling authority notice before publication. An institution's existence or official website does not verify its current fees.
notes: This dataset is a fee-verification registry, not a published fee schedule.
Do not publish a fee estimate as an official fee. Populate feeAmount, feePeriod, feeComponents and academicYear only after checking the applicable current official prospectus or government fee order.
A null feeAmount means the amount is unknown or not verified; it does not mean the fee is zero or waived.
Distinguish tuition, admission charges, deposits, hostel, mess, examination, insurance and other charges when the official source provides that breakdown.
Confirm the exact course, institution, academic year, quota, category and applicable student type before recording a fee.
officialSourceUrl should point to the specific official fee document or official notice when available. A general portal URL is only a starting point and does not prove a fee amount.
lastVerified must remain null until a person has actually checked the applicable source and recorded the review date.
Institution names and links are reference leads; confirm current official URLs and course availability before relying on them.
